text: The second stage of the Orrery is humming in harmonic tune with the stars once more. Those who listen closely near the glass dome can hear the voice of Annam whispering planar truths.
A pack of rogue gnomes tried sneaking into the low furnace to harvest slag-glass. The Peace of Annam kept me from burning 'em, but I chased 'em out with a bellow full of sulfur gas!
A house-sized owl-cat has been nesting in the abandoned pet store on the east gallery. It won't bite thanks to the Peace, but it's knocked over three of my apothecary barrels!
If you hear loud clicking behind the Scriptorium walls, don't panic—it's just the ancient ventilation gears trying to un-rust themselves after a thousand years.
